intro.title: Create a PIN you'll never forget

bullets.title: Set a card PIN that makes sense only to you.
Don't write it down anywhere; keep it in your head.
If you forget it, you can always view it in Smart Banka.

confirmPin.title: Confirm your new PIN

bullets.title: For your next transaction, insert the card into a payment terminal or ATM.
